results.explanation: 😟 Male generic doesn’t address all genders
results.label: Gendered: Titles
results.reason: The male generic does not speak to all genders or gender identities. Many people therefore do not feel included in the dialogue.
results.solution: Use words that address the female gender as well as gender identities that do not follow a binary understanding of gender.
